beats.label: S1 · Retired and adrift
beats.text: Ex-Dolphin Spencer Strasmore takes a job at Anderson Financial and starts pitching current players, while best friend Charles quits football for a car lot he already hates.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Spencer's second-act premise and Charles's restlessness that drives his entire arc.

beats.label: S1 · Chasing Vernon
beats.text: Spencer targets Cowboys star Vernon Littlefield as his first big client, but Vernon's childhood friend Reggie controls the money and blocks every move.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the Vernon–Reggie–Spencer triangle that anchors the season.

beats.label: S1 · Ricky burns bridges
beats.text: Traded to Miami, Ricky Jerret feuds with a teammate wearing his number, loses Annabella, and keeps torching his own second chance in public.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Ricky as the self-sabotaging client Spencer must keep afloat.

beats.label: S1 · The blackmail
beats.text: A woman named Angela threatens to release nude photos of Vernon; Spencer eventually pays her off with his own money to protect the client he doesn't yet officially have.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Spencer personally on the hook for Vernon and reveals a shared past with Angela.

beats.label: S1 · Head in pieces
beats.text: Pushed by Tracy, Spencer finally gets an MRI for the blackouts he's been hiding, confirming the football damage he's been drinking away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Grounds Spencer's mortality subplot and his motive to build something outside the game.

beats.label: S1 · Anderson turns
beats.text: The corporate-yacht video reaches Mr. Anderson, who suspends Joe. Joe commits to launching his own firm and asks Spencer to come with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The rupture that reshapes Spencer's professional life at season's end.

beats.label: S1 · Everyone at a crossroads
beats.text: Spencer weighs Joe's offer, Charles gets a real shot at a comeback, and Vernon, disillusioned with Reggie, is left choosing who actually represents him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The three live threads the next season walks into.

cliffhanger.text: Spencer has been offered a way out of Anderson Financial to build something with Joe, Charles has been handed a route back onto an NFL field, and Vernon is finally seeing Reggie clearly — with his money and his career hanging on what he does about it.
questions: Will Spencer jump ship with Joe and start his own firm?
Can Charles actually make it back in the NFL, and does his marriage survive if he does?
Does Vernon finally cut Reggie loose and commit to Spencer as his advisor?

characters.name: Spencer Strasmore
characters.line: Retired Dolphins star turned rookie financial advisor, hiding TBI symptoms while trying to sign NFL clients.

characters.name: Joe Krutel
characters.line: Spencer's boss-mentor at Anderson Financial; suspended over the yacht-party fallout and now starting his own firm.
characters.note: The one pulling Spencer toward independence.

characters.name: Charles Greane
characters.line: Spencer's best friend, a retired lineman miserable selling cars, offered a shot back into football at season's end.

characters.name: Ricky Jerret
characters.line: Volatile Dolphins receiver, Spencer's problem-child client, single again after blowing up his relationship with Annabella.

characters.name: Vernon Littlefield
characters.line: Cowboys star and Spencer's marquee target; renegotiating his deal and finally souring on Reggie.

characters.name: Reggie
characters.line: Vernon's childhood friend and self-appointed money manager; the antagonist Spencer has to displace.

characters.name: Mr. Anderson
characters.line: Head of Anderson Financial; has turned on Joe over the yacht video and is now effectively the rival firm.

characters.name: Tracy Legette
characters.line: TV reporter and Spencer's love interest; the person who pushed him to finally get the MRI.

characters.name: Jason Antolotti
characters.line: Vernon's agent and Spencer's ally, running the Cowboys contract negotiation.

characters.name: Angela Lee
characters.line: The woman who blackmailed Vernon with nude photos and shares a loaded past with Spencer.
